source: Installed GCC15 manual, no compiler query

interpretation.-M: Dependency rule only; driver implies preprocessing -E, no object or linking. Does not type-check _Static_assert expressions.
interpretation.-MF: Dependency text goes to separate fixed watched file, avoiding verbose/debug output mixing.
interpretation.-B: Pins first compiler-subprogram prefix; actual verbose cc1 command must match after assigned query. Prefix/include is absent to prevent implicit extra include root.
interpretation.-nostdinc/-isystem: Disable default header roots; explicitly list the three installed GCC/multiarch/system include roots. This is conditional installed-header configuration, not default-build/header or library-implementation proof.
